reason: 该插件的主导向是语音转文字输入工具：在 DSH 聊天界面提供麦克风录制并将识别结果回填到输入框。根据 README 与仓库结构可见其核心是本地语音采集与转写（含模型加载、回退策略）并可选接入外部 ASR API，因此归类为媒体工具类的本地优先型用户交互插件。

summaries.zh: 该插件在 DSH 聊天中提供麦克风录音并自动转写为文字的输入方式，可直接回填到输入框并支持本地或云端识别模式。
summaries.en: This plugin provides voice input in DSH by recording speech from the chat interface and inserting the transcription into the input field, with local-first processing or optional cloud transcription provider support.

capabilities: capture microphone audio from the local device
convert speech to text via local Whisper service
download and load ASR models locally
insert recognized text into DSH chat input field
optional OpenAI-compatible cloud transcription provider fallback
read configuration including optional API keys
access network for model and optional API endpoints

reasons.code: README states the plugin adds a one-click mic input flow that fills transcribed text into the DSH input box.
File list and tree show Python recording and transcription components (record.py, server.py, transcribe.py) indicating local audio capture and speech-to-text processing behavior.
README documents optional remote providers (Groq/SiliconFlow) via API configuration, implying external credential and network use.
